title: The War Widens
subtitle: Luga, Staraya Russa and the defence of Odessa
author: R.G. Cruise
phase: II — The Drive into the Soviet Interior
summary: Planned study: The Luga fighting, Soviet operations near Staraya Russa, Romanian operations around Odessa and competing German priorities.
location: Leningrad approaches, Odessa and the central front
outlineTopics: The German effort to resume major advances toward Leningrad.
Army Group North's operations around the Luga defensive system.
Soviet defensive formations protecting the approaches to Leningrad.
The German advance toward Novgorod and the Lake Ilmen region.
The Soviet counteroffensive around Staraya Russa, beginning August 8.
Soviet operational objectives and the pressure placed on German formations.
The Soviet defense of Odessa and the importance of its port and maritime supply connections.
The role of Romanian forces and their command structure.
The continued German operations in Ukraine.
Hitler's August 12 supplement to Directive No. 34.
The expanding disagreement over priorities between Leningrad, Moscow, Ukraine, and the southern economic objectives.
researchStatus: Editorial outline established; full narrative, document locators and the dated military situation require research.
